description: This file contains C# interface definitions for internal stream lifecycle grains used within a testing context. It extends existing stream producer and consumer interfaces with additional test or internal methods.

methods.name: DoBadDeactivateNoClose
methods.description: Asynchronous method to simulate a bad deactivation scenario without closing the stream, used for testing internal stream lifecycle behavior.

methods.name: TestInternalRemoveProducer
methods.description: Asynchronous method to test internal removal of a producer stream given stream ID and provider name.

methods.name: TestBecomeConsumerSlim
methods.description: Asynchronous method to test transitioning a stream into a consumer state in a slimmed-down context.
